title.description: title of Dialog. Can also be passed with a named slot (see the following table)
title.description_zh: Dialog 的标题，也可通过具名 slot 传入

fullscreen.description: whether the Dialog takes up full screen

top.description: value for `margin-top` of Dialog CSS, default is 15vh
top.description_zh: Dialog CSS 中的 margin-top 值

header-class.description: custom class names for header wrapper
header-class.description_zh: header 包装器的自定义类名

body-class.description: custom class names for body wrapper
body-class.description_zh: body 包装器的自定义类名

footer-class.description: custom class names for footer wrapper
footer-class.description_zh: footer 包装器的自定义类名

append-to-body.description: whether to append Dialog itself to body. A nested Dialog should have this attribute set to `true`
append-to-body.description_zh: Dialog 自身是否插入至 body 元素上。嵌套的 Dialog 必须指定该属性并赋值为 true

append-to.description: which element the Dialog appends to. Will override `append-to-body`
append-to.description_zh: Dialog 挂载到哪个 DOM 元素 将覆盖 append-to-body

lock-scroll.description: whether scroll of body is disabled while Dialog is displayed
lock-scroll.description_zh: 是否在 Dialog 出现时将 body 滚动锁定

:open-delay.description_zh: Dialog 打开的延时时间，单位毫秒

:close-delay.description_zh: Dialog 关闭的延时时间，单位毫秒

close-on-click-modal.description: whether the Dialog can be closed by clicking the mask
close-on-click-modal.description_zh: 是否可以通过点击 modal 关闭 Dialog

close-on-press-escape.description: whether the Dialog can be closed by pressing ESC
close-on-press-escape.description_zh: 是否可以通过按下 ESC 关闭 Dialog

show-close.description: whether to show a close button

:before-close.description: callback before Dialog closes, and it will prevent Dialog from closing, use done to close the dialog
:before-close.description_zh: 关闭前的回调，会暂停 Dialog 的关闭. 回调函数内执行 done 参数方法的时候才是真正关闭对话框的时候.

draggable.description_zh: 为 Dialog 启用可拖拽功能

overflow.description: draggable Dialog can overflow the viewport
overflow.description_zh: 可拖拽的 Dialog 是否可以超出视口边界

center.description: whether to align the header and footer in center
center.description_zh: 是否让 Dialog 的 header 和 footer 部分居中排列

align-center.description: whether to align the dialog both horizontally and vertically
align-center.description_zh: 是否水平垂直对齐对话框

destroy-on-close.description: destroy elements in Dialog when closed
destroy-on-close.description_zh: 关闭时销毁 Dialog 中的元素

close-icon.description: custom close icon, default is Close
close-icon.description_zh: 自定义关闭图标，默认为 Close

:z-index.description: same as z-index in native CSS, z-order of dialog
:z-index.description_zh: 和原生的 CSS 的 z-index 相同，改变 z 轴的顺序

events.name: opened
events.description: triggers when the Dialog opening animation ends
events.description_zh: Dialog 打开动画结束时的回调

events.name: closed
events.description: triggers when the Dialog closing animation ends
events.description_zh: Dialog 关闭动画结束时的回调

events.name: open-auto-focus
events.description: triggers after Dialog opens and content focused
events.description_zh: 输入焦点聚焦在 Dialog 内容时的回调

events.name: close-auto-focus
events.description: triggers after Dialog closed and content focused
events.description_zh: 输入焦点从 Dialog 内容失焦时的回调

slots.name: header
slots.description: content of the Dialog header; Replacing this removes the title, but does not remove the close button.
slots.description_zh: Dialog 头部的内容；会替换标题部分，但不会移除关闭按钮

slots.name: footer
slots.description_zh: Dialog 按钮操作区的内容

slots.name: title
slots.description: works the same as the header slot. Use that instead.
slots.description_zh: 与 header 插槽功能相同，请使用 header 插槽
